[LTIE.4.6.2] Truth maintenance does not cross a tier boundary. A
published fact reaches another tier as its schema name and slot values,
asserted there ([NCBK.10.1]), so the receiving tier holds it as an assertion
of its own, with no justifier from the publishing tier, and one fact per
identity ([LFAC.1.7]). If two tiers publish a `logical` fact with the same key
to a third, the third holds one fact; an identical second assert is a no-op
reassertion ([LFAC.2.5]). A retraction in the publishing tier reaches the
receiving tier only if the integrator carries it, and [NCBK.10.1]'s bridge does
not. An author needing tier-wide truth maintenance structures rules so that
exactly one tier publishes a given fact.
